'''2011 Tatooine Regionals Jan Westergard DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jan Westergard]] at [[2011 Tatooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Ghosttrain
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
